summary: Prompts & Citations Studio reliably renders the 5-engine outcome cluster (.aei-m-dots). Each prompt row rendered exactly 5 .aei-mini-dot elements for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Mode with valid status classes and informative tooltips ('ChatGPT: Ölçülmedi', etc.). Volume formats conformed strictly to the 3-tier fallback hierarchy.
